title: MakeClaim
description: One sourced value for one org field of one make. Make dossier identity numbers and blurbs trace back to these claims.

make.description: Make name as recorded in vehicles.json, e.g. 'Cadillac' or 'Mercedes-Benz'.

field.description: Dot-path into make fields, e.g. 'org.hq_city' or 'org.parent'.

value.description: The claimed value, any JSON type. Defaults and allowed enums are in make-fields.md.

tier.description: P = OEM About / corporate / IR / press actually opened, or government filing. S = credible outlet. D = derived from other make claims. unverified = plausible but no findable source. Wikipedia is not tier P.

source_name.description: Human-readable source, e.g. 'Lucid Motors Lucid Headquarters page'.

source_url.description: Required for tier P and S. Omit only for tier D or unverified.

access_date.description: ISO date the claim was captured.

disclosed_by_oem.description: True if the OEM or parent published this value.

inputs.description: Field paths; use make#field for another make's claim.

notes.description: Caveats and provenance in plain language.
